method: Bounded 7-DOF IK, palm down, grasp reference hand+[0.02,0,0.10] m at z=0.86 m; 3 seeds, 100 DLS iterations; 8 mm position / 8 deg rotation tolerance. 55 mm arm centerline/table clearance proxy, no centerline crossing. 40k CAD pedestal samples with 12 mm furniture clearance. Not full-mesh swept-motion collision verification or global optimization.
